description: This file defines the 'Config' class and related nested classes within the 'Thunder::Plugin' namespace. It includes configuration data structures, environment settings, and methods for managing plugin configuration, including serialization and path generation.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Main configuration class for plugins, including nested classes for environment and root configuration, with methods for serialization, path management, and conversion to service metadata.

classes.name: Config::Environment
classes.description: Represents environment variables with key, value, and scope.

classes.name: Config::RootConfig
classes.description: Holds root configuration parameters such as locator, user, mode, and environment list.

classes.name: Config::Setting
classes.description: Utility class for logging configuration settings.

methods.name: DataPath
methods.description: Generates data path based on base path and class name.

methods.name: PersistentPath
methods.description: Generates persistent storage path based on base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: VolatilePath
methods.description: Generates volatile storage path based on base path and postfix or callsign.

methods.name: operator Exchange::Controller::IMetadata::Data::Service
methods.description: Converts configuration data into service metadata structure.

methods.name: HostType
methods.description: Determines the host type based on mode setting.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Returns a list of environment variables as RPC objects.

methods.name: IsSameInstance
methods.description: Checks if another Config instance refers to the same plugin instance based on locator and class name.
